propositions: AC checklist items carrying operational-evidence markers (deploy, prod, live-run, store-surgery, etc.) but lacking [operator-attested] tags are not surfaced at plan time, causing completion-verifier failures downstream

A deterministic, advisory (non-blocking) lexicon lint that flags untagged operational-evidence AC items must be added to p6_ac_quality without introducing a new DET check or modifying DET_CHECKS cardinality
The plan-time lint and completion-verifier enrichment path must share a single regex matcher for [operator-attested] tags to ensure agreement on what constitutes a tagged item

The lint must be validated against a frozen historical AC corpus from 556 E1 tickets (3091 AC items, 31 pre-tagged) with measured precision ≥70%, flag rate ≤5%, and both known failing cases (115b, 8c4f) firing as unit-test fixtures
The eval result must be committed as a git ancestor of the lint activation, establishing deterministic pre-registration before the lint becomes active
